look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions. Same look as the earlier films of this series.

scenes.name: 3D printing
scenes.desc: Title beside our DHSP mesh on a build plate.

scenes.name: How a printer builds
scenes.desc: The slicer cuts the real mesh into layers; each layer is an outline, filled.

scenes.name: Inside or outside?
scenes.desc: Ray crossings: odd inside, even outside; a gap makes the fill leak.

scenes.name: The watertight rule
scenes.desc: Every edge shared by exactly two triangles; one = hole, three = fin.

scenes.name: Holes on our meshes
scenes.desc: DHSP: 9,000 edges all closed. MeshAnything: 65 hole edges, 10 fins.

scenes.name: Which side is out
scenes.desc: Corner order gives each triangle an outside; neighbours must agree.

scenes.name: Our print export
scenes.desc: Largest piece, outward, turn upright, 180 mm, feet on the plate, STL.

scenes.name: Which of ours can print
scenes.desc: Four pass: Poisson (watertight), Point2Mesh, DHSP, SAP.

scenes.name: Closed by design
scenes.desc: Inside-outside solvers and closed skins stay closed; the rest do not.

scenes.name: Ready for the printer
scenes.desc: Size, volume, supports under the arms, STL and coloured OBJ.

scenes.name: In one line
scenes.desc: 3D printing in one sentence; next, the code pipeline.
